entity: Senegal's 2026 external debt service relative to export earnings
what_we_add: 54% of 2024 exports, $4.44B, top of 108 low- and middle-income countries
why: The Bank-Fund DSA names Senegal and states the same finding in words: the external debt-service-to-exports ratio breaches its threshold in 2026 on Eurobond amortizations. The JPMorgan $9.7B and budget figures are total debt service, a different definition, so no contradiction. No source has 54% or the 108-country rank.
